item.title: Their customer service is great.
item.description:
Steam restored an entire library of deleted games for a player who had been struggling with their mental health. The player, known as 3lizardintrenchcoat, explained that they had spent years removing games they'd purchased and loved during difficult periods in their life. After their mental health began improving, they regretted losing so many games and decided to contact Steam Support, hoping they might be able to recover at least a few of them. They even explained that if restoring the games wasn't possible, simply receiving a list of everything they'd previously owned would mean the world to them. However, Steam Support employee Lucy went one step further, restoring their entire deleted game library in less than 24 hours without asking them to repurchase anything. The player later shared the interaction, praising Valve for its kindness and understanding:
Microsoft would punch your infant child if it meant you'd continue you subscription. Steam would send an armed tactical squad to physically rescue your stolen Steam Deck.

item.description: *edit: the correct petition with the larger amount of signatures is now linked, thanks to those who pointed it out as organizing is just as important as acting*. A lot of people who have spent their whole lives being fed a constant stream of propaganda demonizing Democrats and isolating them from the rest of the country have taken a chance with the other side. I believe that if the chance they took doesn’t show them real change for the better, we may never have another chance to take away the stranglehold that the right’s propaganda engines have on America. I don’t think that Hakeem Jeffries is willing or capable of being the force for change that this country needs. Time and time again him and Chuck Schumer have shown themselves all too happy to perpetuate the status quo. We don’t need the status quo, we need dramatic progress. Please consider signing/calling your house members and senators telling them not to elect Jeffries and Schumer. item.title: GovBrief Today #643
item.description: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill warned 12 fuel companies this week that Donald Trump's lifting of Russian diesel sanctions won't protect them. Congress banned Russian fuel in 2022 after Vladimir Putin invaded Ukraine. Trump made a deal with Putin last month anyway, and the sanctions came off without the certification or congressional review the law requires, as tankers loaded with Russian diesel sailed for the East Coast. Sherrill's letter warns of millions of dollars in penalties, and she said the law gives prosecutors five years to act while Trump leaves office in two. "People are on notice," she told reporters on Wednesday, a day after voters handed both chambers of Congress to Democrats. I've emailed 9,805 stories over 643 straight nights, free and without ads. item.title: CERN Physicists Find Evidence of B0 Decay
item.description: CERN Physicists Find Evidence of B0 Decay Oktay Yürük aka Oktay74tn, science and tech content https://imgur.com/user/Oktay74tn This is the magnet of the LHCb, CERN's Large Hadron Collider beauty experiment. A 42-year search has come to an end. Physicists measured the decay of the B0 meson, a rare 1.03 in 10 billion event according to the Standard Model. VELO is the Vertex Locator of the LHCb. The detector is located at 7 millimeters from the LHC beam and operates at -25 °C. RICH is the Ring imaging Cherenkov detector. It is a tracking system for particle identification. The B0 meson is composed of a beauty antiquark and a down quark. Its rest mass is 5279.65 megaelectronvolts per c squared. c is the speed of light in vacuum (299,792.458 kilometers or 186,282 miles per second). The B0 meson decays into a pair of muons. These Feynman diagrams describe the temporal sequence of the B0 decay. The virtual intermediate particles are shown in blue and purple: the charged W- and the neutral Z-bosons from the Standard Model and the Z-prime boson and vector leptoquark from New Physics. This plot shows the mass distribution of the B0 events with the fit curve overlaid. According to the new data, the decay's branching fraction is 1.26 in 10 billion. The particle has a lifetime of 1.42 picoseconds (ps). One picosecond is a trillionths of a second. This is the two-dimensional profile likelihood of the decay. The black dot marks the best fit value. The red dotted line represents the predictions of the Standard Model that fits the measurements. The scientists are about to enter the Zeptoverse, the subatomic world at a scale of 10 to the minus 21 meters. _________________________________________________________________ Evidence for the decay ??→?+​?− and improved measurements of the decay ???→?+​?− LHCb collaboration https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00230 CERN Physicists Find Evidence of Ultra-Rare Particle Decay https://www.sci.news/physics/cern-ultra-rare-particle-decay-15171.html What is the 'zeptoverse'?
